question: Which Sultan was defeated by Babur in the first battle of Panipat 1526?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ibrahim Lodi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ibrahim Lodi **was the** Sultan** who was **defeated by Babur **in the **first battle of Panipat in 1526.**
 
• This battle marked the beginning of the **Mughal Empire** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sikandar Lodi **was the** father of Ibrahim Lodi **and ruled the Delhi Sultanate before him.
 
• Ibrahim Lodi's brother, Mahmud Lodi, declared himself Sultan and continued to resist Mughal forces. He provided around 4,000 Afghan soldiers to Rana Sanga in the Battle of Khanwa in 1527. After that defeat, Mahmud Lodi fled eastwards and again posed a challenge to Babur two years later at the Battle of Ghaghra in 1529.
 
• **Bahlul Lodi** was the** founder of the Lodi dynasty **and ruled the **Delhi Sultanate** before Sikandar Lodi.
